text:
Most of my wardrobe is Lulu because they have clothing and apparel for any occasion. For me, comfort & convenience is priority, whether working out or going out for the evening. I haven't purchased a pair of jeans, "slacks", dress shirts, or even blazers by any other brands in well over a decade because I know I can rely on high quality merch that's easy to wear & will last long. With such a selection, I've continued to refresh my look with ABC pants, seasonal tops, and workout gear, knowing I'll have the same comfort & fits. With plenty of styles, colors, and materials to choose from, it's easy to keep my style fresh every time I add a new piece.
The Robson location is the only store I ever shop in the flesh because I can just as easily follow the "We Made Too Much" category online for sales on different colors & materials of what I know will fit already, plus lots of bonus Aeroplan points!
At this location, it really seems like each staff member enjoy their jobs. I don't think they could fake their consistently exceptional customer service! The occasions I go in alone, the staff are always flying around helping with sizes, etc... So what I appreciate the most in this store are the honest opinions from whoever is helping me in the fitting room area. If it doesn't look right, they will come up with another option, but when they give me a green light, I can feel confident with my purchases. Their return/exchange policies for members are the easiest I've experienced. Their turn around time with alterations is never more than five days, & often less. It's an uplifting, above & beyond experience, from their greeters to the till👌😊

Today, my wanderings took me to a place I don't usually go .
Lululemon.
Yeah, I know.
Me, a guy who's practically colorblind and has zero patience for shopping, stepping into the world of athletic wear. My mission? A few shirts.
My usual experience in these places? A test of endurance.
My eyes glazing over different shades of light green and light blue.
ready to just find a quiet corner somewhere. And that’s when Natalie ask me if I need any help .
I think she saw the quiet frustration in my eyes .
The unspoken plea of a man who just wanted to buy some damn shirts and get out.
She moved with the precision of a seasoned guide, pulling options, getting the colors right and done .
before I could even fully register what was happening.
In and out.
A surgical strike. Natalie, you're a godsend.
You made what I expected to be a chore into a surprisingly pleasant experience.
So, if you find yourself at Lululemon, and you're not entirely sure where to begin, seek out Natali.
I will return that’s for sure.

Yesterday, I made a large purchase at the flagship store. The cashier, an Asian female employee with glasses and medium-length hair, showed a very impatient attitude throughout the checkout process. After completing the payment, she did not fold the clothes and simply handed me the receipt without any care.

This was by far the worst experience I have ever had at Lululemon.

I love ❤️ Chip Wilson’s collections because for a female because  you can wear comfortable active wear pants that are loose, good material and made for the right purpose. As a customer at least you can find a good decent pair of pants….. Also his collections for fun, colorful, and eye 👁️ capturing. You feel good and look good.

I have been a regular consumer of Lululemon since their flagship store opened in Vancouver in 2014.

That ended today.
I'll tell you why....

The first time I bought their short tennis style skirt was back in 2023.
I ordered another one online in white, and when it arrived I took it in store to get a different size, even though the size I ordered was my size and the black I already had was that same size...strange.

I wore the black one I have had for two years and is a size 10 into the store to exchange the new one that had arrived. I asked service why the one that was shipped was so tight as it is my size and the same I'm currently wearing....they didn't know and suggested that since their products were manufactured in different countries they are not always aligned in terms of style and size....wow..really??

He suggested that he grab me one from the store and compare.
Brought over my size but it was not nearly the same quality or look. It had strange lines in the fabric. The manager came over and was puzzled why two identical products look so different.
One was manufactured in Vietnam and the other in Thailand.
So, really depending on which country ships your product is which quality you'll be getting.

I felt generous and decided to give them one more chance.
I ordered a size up online with the clerk.
Today it arrived and it was a disaster (see pic.)
Extremely poor quality, strange flawed lines in the fabric randomly inconsistent, and it comes packaged heavily wrinkled, which is a bit of a problem, because you can't iron this product.
I went back to the store for the second time and returned it.
Even their in-store products upon touch you can feel it just isn't the same premium quality anymore. Thinner, cheaper, rougher material.
Quite a few times I’ve seen in store products that are dirty or stained. Nothing like picking up a shirt or tank top with someone’s deodorant stain to gross you out.
Attention to detail and floor management needs serious attention.
The staff are friendly but in my book dirty merchandise on hangers trumps staff smiles to drive me away.

So, really they are now selling you lesser quality but still for the same premium price.

I mean just the fact that they put their name on products that are manufactured in random places that there's no guarantee of consistency and quality representing the brand....just blows my mind.
I think my local dollar store has more of a compass when it comes to product management.

Writing this actually makes me a little sad, because I remember what Lululemon used to be like. Consistent, un-compromised high quality athletic wear.
Ever since Chip Wilson left the quality went to Hell.

11 years I have been a Lululemon customer.
Their non-existent quality control measures, inconsistency and poor manufacturing cost them my decade of business today.

store_name: Lululemon Georgia Street Pacific Centre Vancouver
text: The customer service was excellent; Majo helped me find a warm sweater to keep me cozy. She listened to what I needed and picked out a couple of pieces for me to try. It was a fantastic shopping experience with her assistance.

store_name: Lululemon Georgia Street Pacific Centre Vancouver
text:
Exceptional service - Franklin and Gracia.

Went above and beyond, grabbed items from the mannequin for me. Helped me pick out the T-shirt as well (they all look the same to me lmao, but the fabrics are different which is important when selecting for your needs - thank you for the assistance).

Ended up purchasing 7" shorts from Alo and 5" shorts from Lululemon. Lululemon culture/and QC was significantly better. After checking the items at home, quality and consistency was SIGNIFICANTLY better at Lululemon.

I had wanted to check Alo (currently privately held company, could potentially look to go public to scale IMO), to see if the rumors regarding their effort and respect were justified. I was shocked. You have to do due diligence when shopping at Alo, (or just purchase from Lululemon IMO). I had asked for a specific color that they "had in the back", I came home and noticed a pin through the fabric, and the Alo tag marked up - which I should have checked). Unacceptable, especially for shorts over $100.

Lululemon was impressive. Not the same experience at Alo. First time there, no relation to the companies. Not a Lululemon shareholder (although I might consider it now lmao), or ever was.

store_name: Lululemon Georgia Street Pacific Centre Vancouver
text:
Absolutely ridiculous experience at Lululemon. One pant leg is a full 2 inches longer than the other!

I reached out for support after just a few weeks of owning them, and here’s the response they hit me with:

“Based on the photos provided, your product is not showing any signs of any quality issues or defects…”

Excuse me? Two pant legs not matching is apparently normal now?

Safe to say I won’t be shopping here again.

Future shoppers: bring a measuring tape with you unless you want to DIY tailor your overpriced athleisure.

store_name: Lululemon Georgia Street Pacific Centre Vancouver
text:
On January 14th I was at your Pacific Centre location with my wife and young son. I normally shop at your Burrard location.

I walked in and tried to look around on my own. There were two staff members, but instead of helping customers they were chatting with each other and trying things on in front of the mirror. We didn’t even hear a simple “hello” or “welcome.” They just kept talking to each other.

I was there at around 4:14 PM and since no one paid attention to us, we left and went to the Burrard location instead.

It’s the same brand but two completely different customer service experiences. Burrard staff are amazing and very attentive, but this location doesn’t reflect Lululemon at all actually, it felt like there was no customer service.

store_name: Lululemon Georgia Street Pacific Centre Vancouver
text:
On December 6, 2025 when I went to make an exchange at the Pacific Centre location, the educator who assisted me was very rude and displayed poor customer service. I understand she may be experiencing something in her personal life, but professionalism is still important while at work.
Educator ID: 99994000212606
Register: 2

They claim this is the first Lululemon store opened by Chip Wilson, but honestly, it doesn’t feel like it. If it’s truly such an important and historic location for the brand, you would expect it to be designed and presented in a way that reflects that significance — something unique or memorable.

The store layout is also a bit strange. There are two completely separate sections for men and women, connected only by a narrow corridor. The men’s section is noticeably smaller and feels like an afterthought, with very limited product selection and almost no variety.

Overall, I didn’t enjoy visiting this branch. If you’re looking for a wide range of items or a more special experience, this location might not be worth the trip.

Just don't buy items. They do not guarantee to look into the quality after 1 year of purchasing the product. This purse was mainly in my closet and started pealing off. Came to the store for them to bring to quality control and was told that they do not do that if item pass the one year mark - New policy. BUYER BEWARE!

It seems that the return and exchange policies differ between the Robson store and the Kitsilano store.

I came here a few weeks after purchasing 13 items to return two of them. They kept insisting that a refund was not possible, and that even store credit on a gift card could not be given. It honestly felt like no one really understood the return policy, and the explanation I was given was unclear and inconsistent.

They told me that only a size exchange was possible. While checking the item, I noticed hair and dust on it, so I asked the staff member standing there (wearing glasses with braided hair) if there was another new item available. She looked at me like I was being unreasonable and repeatedly said that it was a new item. I already know it was supposed to be new, but seeing hair and dust on it made me uncomfortable.

While she went to the back, I could see other staff members looking at me, and it felt very unpleasant and unprofessional. The whole interaction made me feel uncomfortable and disrespected.

After that, I went to the Robson store, where I was able to exchange my size, receive product recommendations, and get my refund as store credit on a gift card without any issues.

I will not be returning to this location.

The only lululemon location I’ll visit!! As an avid lululemon-wearer and fitness instructor, I spend more time than I would care to admit in this store, and I have always loved my visits at lululemon West 4th. The staff is always ready to help, providing ideas, insights, sizes, colours and styles for your needs, and make everyone feel welcomed. Team members Parker and Clara have always made my visits unique, with their masterful customer service, kindness, care and attention to detail. Even at the sake of convenience, I will wait and do my shopping at the West 4th location. The layout and size of the store allows for ease, and doesn’t cause claustrophobia during busy hours, but rather flows effortlessly from the start to end of your shopping experience.

Would be good to re-evaluate your in-store policies and ensure your employees are all on the same page.

Came in around noon and wanted to purchase something, but did not bring my gift card out. One of the counter staff let me leave my name on a piece of paper and told me it’d be possible to keep it behind the counter for me to come back and pick up later in the day.

I returned at 7pm to find out the item was no longer there, and I couldn’t find it in-store and had to find out from someone else in a separate shift that they have a no-hold policy for final sale items.

Please have the decency to inform me you can’t hold the items, rather than cause me to make a wasted trip down to find out you’ve run it back into the store without my knowledge. Disappointing experience, with poor service recovery from the folks in the 2nd shift too.

I had a wonderful experience , thanks to Avika. Her customer service was truly outstanding, she was polite, attentive, and went out of her way to make sure I found exactly what I needed. She handled everything with patience and a genuine smile, which made the entire shopping experience smooth and enjoyable.
Very helpful staff lots of inventory and sizes available. Clean and organized change rooms, good clearance sale rack always at  the back, line up moved quickly and counter staff were very kind

Jamal was super helpful! Even holding up pants to help decide what fit I was looking for, for my husband. Engaged with us almost immediately and was jist overall a friendly staff member.  Liked his style as well! Great customer service!

I had such a great shopping experience thanks to Anne! She was incredibly kind and helpful from the moment I walked in. Anne helped me find the right sizes, suggested styles that suited me perfectly, and made sure I found pieces I absolutely loved. Her attention to detail and warm attitude made the whole experience enjoyable and stress-free. Thank you, Anne, for your amazing service. You truly made my day!

Lululemon Sweat Collective Program Sucks & Rules/Policy Truly Sucks For Me Because I really really truly wanted one specific sports bra so badly since that my friend Naomi is a member at Lululemon & gets at 25% off discount for herself & personal use only but that is not what my friend Naomi has told me about it yesterday on Monday January 5th , she said that she is a member & told me to tell you on which items or item that I want & she said that she'll buy it for me & I pay her back via e transfer. I just really really truly wish that I can be a member too but unfortunately I am not a instructor, athlete, nurse or anything like that so Unfortunately I can't apply for it.

Had such a great experience at this Lululemon location! Wing was incredibly friendly, patient, and super knowledgeable. She walked me through so many of their products, explained the differences clearly, and helped me find exactly what I needed. Her service was warm, thoughtful, and never pushy.

Really appreciate her professionalism — made my shopping experience so smooth and enjoyable. Thank you, Wing!

I would like to thank you customer representative at lululemon. I m sorry I didn’t ask your name but today you were amazing and have understood what a customer wants. I was so grateful to meet someone who took care of customer very well.
I purchased a pants there and didn’t realize I grabbed the wrong size from size 4 to size 2 last Friday (Black Friday). When I was home and found out that I got it the wrong size so I went back the store today. Please give her applause👏👏👏 she helped me find size 4 that I was looking for thoroughly on the shelf somehow she couldn’t find it then grabbed me the other color if I want it. So I want to try it out before then I went to try and suddenly found the right color and the right size on the shelf in the fitting room. I went back to her and say thank you for helping and great service from her. I felt so happy that I get the right size of my pants and happy about lululemon customer representative there. Thank you again.

Wednesday, January 14th, 8:00–8:15 PM:

My boyfriend and I were shopping at your store, and I was looking for the correct size of a pair of flared pants on the sales floor.

(I apologize in advance for describing the associate’s physical characteristics, as I was unable to note her name from the name tag.)

A young, mid-height, blonde-curly hair (bun) associate with an Eastern European accent approached us and asked if we needed assistance. We asked her to help determine which size might suit me best. Without any clear context, she suddenly asked, “Do you want to try the new one?” I replied, “Sure, which one is the new one?”

At that point, she smirked in a noticeably sarcastic and dismissive manner and responded, “Okay, what’s your size?” Her tone and behavior felt unnecessary and unprofessional.

I asked her why she was laughing, to which she replied, “Because I can.” I then told her that her behavior came across as rude toward us as customers. She responded aggressively by saying, “I don’t tolerate any violations!” a statement that was both confusing and inappropriate given the situation.

As a result of this interaction, we felt uncomfortable and decided to leave the store. We will not be returning for future shopping. I believe this associate would benefit from additional training on customer service standards in Canada, as her conduct did not align with respectful or professional customer interaction.

Selection could be better. Not my size available in the items I wanted to try on for fit. Good workers all around. Karen was lovely. So personable and such a kind soul. He made my daughter and I's day on a very busy birthday weekend. I hope to see him again when we are back in town. Thank you Richmond Center. - From the woman with the "so cute" hermes bag 😉

Busy store inside Richmond mall, long line to pay on the weekend. Not a large store, minimal selection of men and women items. The location downtown is significantly larger with a better selection.

Somewhat difficult to find parking at the mall on the weekend, there are a lot less parking lots now than a few years ago.

This location had a few racks of discounted items which I have not seen at other locations.

I had one of the most meaningful retail experiences of my life at the Brentwood Lululemon.

My Everywhere Crossbody Bag was stolen from my car two days before my birthday. When I went into the store to replace it, Shayla, the store manager, learned about the theft and generously gifted me the bag.

Afterward, I shared with her that in December I had lost a close friend and that the funeral had taken place the day before my bag was stolen. Shayla was incredibly kind, compassionate, and reassuring.

What made this moment especially meaningful to me was that I had originally bought the bag months earlier as an act of self-care after a difficult breakup, replacing a seven-year-old all night festival bag that was falling apart. Losing it felt discouraging, and Shayla’s kindness meant far more than just receiving a replacement.

This was so much more than customer service. It was genuine human kindness. I will never forget this experience, and I will always associate Lululemon with compassion because of her. Thank you, Shayla, and thank you to the Brentwood team.

Very unpleasant experience. I usually dont write this, but cashier who helped me today seemed very unmotivated to work. Very awkard customer service. (Didnt even fold my clothes after purchase.)  It seems like i was having flea market quality customer service (even worse). The staff around change room was very helpful though. I would not go this location ever.

The other day, I visited Lululemon to buy some gifts for my family in Thailand. There, I met Kevin, a very kind and funny employee who greeted me warmly and made me feel welcomed. As I was searching for gifts, looking somewhat lost and confused with various thoughts running through my mind, Kevin approached me with friendly small talk and kindness. After narrowing down my preferences, he helped me find the item I wanted. When we realized it wasn't available at that location, Kevin went above and beyond by asking where I lived. He then found the closest store to my place that had the size and color of socks I wanted. Kevin is the best, and I highly recommend this location.

The store pop-up is amazing. I have been visiting this store since I live close by and been a lululemon fan. Today, I was trying the smooth spacer pull over hoodie.Rho, helped me to find the right size and she ordered it for me. The overall experience is amazing with a friendly and welcoming team.

I wish this pop up store will be permanent and not just a pop-up.

I usually enjoy shopping at Lululemon, but this experience was very upsetting.

My boyfriend was trying on clothes in the fitting room, and I briefly stepped inside only to hand him a jacket and help decide what he should try on first. There was nothing inappropriate happening.

Without any warning or verbal notice, an employee suddenly pulled the fitting room curtain fully open and told us that two people were not allowed inside. This was extremely embarrassing and felt like a complete violation of privacy.

If there is a policy, it should be communicated verbally and respectfully first, not by forcefully opening a curtain while customers are inside. The employee appeared to be the oldest staff member in the store, which made the lack of professionalism even more disappointing.

I hope Lululemon provides better training on customer privacy and respectful communication. This experience has negatively affected my impression of the brand.

UPDATE: Manager Stephanie called and apologized and they are sending me the correct item. Thank you!!

Ordered an item online for pick up, they put the wrong item in the bag. When I got home I noticed it’s not what I ordered. Called several times no answer so I can get the item I paid for. Disappointed.

I visited this store during Black Friday week and had a great experience. A young gentleman, I believe his name was Soroosh, was incredibly helpful and patient while I shopped for my husband. Everything about the mens section he knew very well, would definitely come again!

I give 5/5 to products : design, cut, material…fantastic.
But I give 1 to their online shopping services.

Imagine you buy something online , you see “ package ready for shipment” , next day :” shipped “ then after a week it says “ Undeliverable “ ????? So I contacted customer service which of course is a computerized conversation , and all I heard was : “ oh , that product was sold out “

Ok, then how something that was NONEXISTENT in the first place was SHIPPED? And after one week UNDELIVERABLE??? Like the package dropped dead on the way to destination address?
Come on guys!!!!
I’ve always supported lululemon as being Canadian, BC based company, but this ?!!! Extremely disappointed.

A few staff members made a mistake with my purchase, and it was a bit stressful at first. But Avalon the manager at Lululemon Park Royal, was truly amazing. She was so kind, understanding, and professional. She followed up with me and made sure everything was handled perfectly. I really appreciate her support and the way she cared. Thank you, Avalon — you turned a stressful situation into a positive one.
🙏🥰

I have had some good experiences at both the ladies side and the men’s side of the store. All the staff is friendly and helpful. My wife needed to see if the store does repairs and after speaking to a helpful associate they decided to exchange them for a new pair. It was so unexpected and kind and we will definitely be back
